descriptions.w3d_s20_dispatch_all_targets_801aa79c: Appears to dispatch every target of an item's record through the secondary base handler table, restoring a guard field when it was set.
descriptions.w3d_s20_dispatch_item_targets_801aa8cc: Appears to dispatch an item's single target or each target of its list through the secondary base handler table, restoring a guard field afterwards.
